reference.question: Find the cube root of \(-27/64\). Write the result as a fraction in simplest form.
reference.solution:
Method 1: Recognize cubes in the fraction

\(27=3^3\) and \(64=4^3\), so \((-3/4)^3=-27/64\). The cube root is \(-3/4\).
